BareMac measures files on your Desktop to find large and duplicate files. It reads names, sizes and dates, and nothing ever leaves your Mac.
BareMac measures files in Documents to find large and duplicate files. It reads names, sizes and dates, and nothing ever leaves your Mac.
BareMac measures files in Downloads to find large and duplicate files. It reads names, sizes and dates, and nothing ever leaves your Mac.
BareMac measures folders you choose on removable drives for the Space Map. Nothing ever leaves your Mac.
BareMac measures folders you choose on network drives for the Space Map. Nothing is sent anywhere.
